releaseNotes: Workbook Audit tables now show finding names, locations and repair actions clearly without hiding important text - full details are also one hover away on every cell.

Finding details and repair previews are easier to read: the details panel is resizable and repair rows show the full action name, the key before and after values, and a short risk label with the full explanation on hover.
Conflicting repairs on the same cell are now announced in a clear warning banner before anything is applied - you choose one.
The Review Actions header shows how many safe, review-and-confirm and guided actions the scan found.

Manual-review findings now provide stronger guidance: used-range findings point to the exact cell where bloat starts, and every manual finding carries a diagnostic action such as Go to Cell or cycle/trace views.
Improved region detection reduces false helper-cell warnings around structured titles and headings above tables.
